items.claim: Saidyokub slowed down and didn't do much in his UFC debut against Nicolas Dalby.
items.quote: He just lost his UFC debut against Nicolas Dalby because he kind of slowed down, didn't do [ __ ] 20 significant strikes in that entire fight.

items.claim: Vagayev has great cardio and will fight for a full 15 minutes without slowing down.
items.quote: I went through Vagayev's fight tape and that dude has cardio. He will fight for a full 15 minutes and he doesn't really slow down.

items.claim: Rizvan Kuniev won his fight against Jailton Almeida by throwing hands, defending takedowns, and holding him against the cage.
items.quote: Rizvan won this fight by actually throwing hands, defending takedowns, and kind of holding Jailton against the cage.

items.claim: Tyrell Fortune's takedown defense is not great and he can be taken down.
items.quote: The issue is his takedown defense is not great. He can be taken down.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev threw around 400 significant strikes in a three-round Contender Series fight.
items.quote: he threw like 400 strikes in a three-round Contender Series fight.

items.claim: Wellington Turman is coming off a three-year layoff and three losses in a row.
items.quote: He's coming off three losses in a row to decent fighters... And then he took a three-year layoff and now here he is back after three years no fighting.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov knocked out Adam Fugitt last year.
items.quote: He knocked out Adam Fugitt last year around this time

items.claim: Steve Erceg was knocked out by Kai Kara-France.
items.quote: We watched him get knocked out by Kai Kara-France.
